summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his study of prayer timings from the book Al-Wajeez, focusing on the narration of Jabir regarding the five daily prayers. He explains the scholarly difference of opinion on whether the narration of Jabir describes the bare minimum times for prayer validity or the optimal and acceptable times. Sh. Ali Mashhour then presents Imam al-Bukhari's commentary on this narration, detailing the specific start and end times for each of the five prayers: Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and Fajr, with reference to authentic narrations from Sahih Muslim. The lecture establishes the framework for understanding prayer timings in Islamic jurisprudence.
